FAQ

Good to know.

How quickly can you come out?

Leaks and storm damage are made safe as soon as we can, often the same or next day. Quote visits are usually within a week.

Do you charge for quotes?

No. Surveys and written quotes are always free, with no obligation.

Are you insured?

Yes. We carry full public liability insurance and we're happy to show you the certificate before we start.

What guarantee do I get?

New roofs and re-roofs carry a 10-year workmanship guarantee. Repairs are guaranteed for 12 months.

Will I need scaffolding?

Many small repairs can be done safely from ladders. Bigger jobs need scaffolding, and it's always included in your quote.

How do I pay?

Bank transfer or card. Larger jobs take a small materials deposit, with the rest paid when you're happy.
